turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Sanibonani, namukelekile kwi-module egqugquzela usiko lokufunda emabangeni aphansi.
turns.en: Hello, you are welcome to the module that promotes a culture of reading in the foundation phase.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ubuwazi nje ukuthi izingane ezifunda njalo zenza kangcono esikoleni kunalezi ezingafundi nhlobo?
turns.en: Did you just know that children who read regularly do better in school than those who do not read at all?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kokufundela ukuzijabulisa nalokho kufunda okuhleliwe okwenziwa uthisha.
turns.en: There is a connection between reading for pleasure and that structured reading done by the teacher.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Therefore, how do we encourage them?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ngakho-ke, sibakhuthaza kanjani abafundi bethu ukuba bakujabulele ukufunda?
turns.en: Therefore, how do we encourage our learners to enjoy reading?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kule module, siqala ngokubheka izimo zengqondo nezinkolelo kanye nokuziphatha ngokufunda, bese sibheka izindlela zokugqugquzela isiko lokufunda esikoleni.
turns.en: In this module, we start by looking at attitudes and beliefs as well as behavior regarding reading, and then we look at ways to promote a culture of reading in school.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emva kokuqeda umsebenzi wale module, uzokwazi, one, ukuthi luyini usiko lokufunda nokuthi lubaluleke ngani.
turns.en: After completing the work of this module, you will know, one, what a culture of reading is and why it is important.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Two, ukukhomba ukuqonda kokuthi yiliphi iqhaza uthisha okumele alibambe ekugqugquzeleni usiko
turns.en: Two, to identify the understanding of what role the teacher must play in promoting a culture

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: isha okumele alibambe ekugqugquzeleni usiko lokufunda esikoleni.
turns.en: ...teacher must play in promoting a culture of reading in school.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Three, ukuchaza ukuthi angalwenza kanjani usiko lokufunda esikoleni.
turns.en: Three, to explain how they can make a culture of reading in school.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Four, ukubona izinsiza ezifanele ongazisebenzisa ukuqala umtapo wolwazi waseklasini, phecelezi, ikhona lokufunda.
turns.en: Four, to identify appropriate resources you can use to start a classroom library, in other words, a reading corner.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Five, ukuthola ukuthi obani ababalulekile ongasisebenzisana nabo ukugqugqumezela usiko lokufunda esikoleni.
turns.en: Five, to find out who are the important people you can work with to promote a culture of reading in school.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Le module izokusiza kakhulu ekubambisaneni ne-SMT ukuze isikole sonke sikwazi ukuhlanganyela ekugqugquzeleni usiko lokufunda.
turns.en: This module will help you a lot in collaborating with the SMT so that the whole school can participate in promoting a culture of reading.
